notes:
This search confirms what the subject name suggests: "underwater basket weaving" is a real phrase, but it's used only as a joke idiom, a satirical fake university, and a craft brand name — never as an actual toddler activity anyone offers. Halton Hills' own recreation programming for toddlers this fall covers things like dance and skateboarding, with no mention of anything resembling this.
